description:
Title: OEE

Write a process, that collects relevant information from a machine, and calculated the Overall Equipment Efficiency (OEE).
If the OEE falls below a certain value/percentage, stop the machine and send an email to an engineer.
When the machine is restarted, continue measuring.
When the machine is disconnected, stop the process.
generated_bpmn_xml:
<bpmn:definitions xmlns:bpmn="http://www.omg.org/spec/BPMN/20100524/MODEL" xmlns:xsi="http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema-instance" xmlns:xsd="http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema" id="Definitions_OEE" targetNamespace="http://example.com/bpmn/oee">
  <bpmn:process id="Process_OEE" name="OEE" isExecutable="false">
    <bpmn:startEvent id="Start_Measurement" name="Start measurement">
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Start</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:startEvent>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_Measure_Merge" name="Measurement merge">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Start</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Restart_Resume</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Continue</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_To_Availability</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:exclusiveGateway>
    <bpmn:serviceTask id="Task_Collect_Availability" name="Collect availability data">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_To_Availability</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_To_Performance</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:serviceTask>
    <bpmn:serviceTask id="Task_Collect_Performance" name="Collect performance data">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_To_Performance</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_To_Quality</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:serviceTask>
    <bpmn:serviceTask id="Task_Collect_Quality" name="Collect quality data">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_To_Quality</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_To_Calculate</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:serviceTask>
    <bpmn:serviceTask id="Task_Calculate" name="Calculate OEE">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_To_Calculate</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_To_Check</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:serviceTask>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_OEE_Check" name="OEE below threshold?" default="Flow_Continue">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_To_Check</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Below_Threshold</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Continue</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:exclusiveGateway>
    <bpmn:serviceTask id="Task_Stop_Machine" name="Stop machine">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Below_Threshold</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_To_Email</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:serviceTask>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_Send_Email" name="Send email to engineer">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_To_Email</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_To_Wait_Restart</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:sendTask>
    <bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent id="Event_Wait_Restart" name="Machine restarted">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_To_Wait_Restart</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Restart_Resume</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:messageEventDefinition id="MED_Restart"/>
    </bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent>
    <bpmn:subProcess id="Sub_Machine_Disconnected" name="Machine disconnected" triggeredByEvent="true">
      <bpmn:startEvent id="Start_Disconnected" name="Machine disconnected" isInterrupting="true">
        <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Disconnect_End</bpmn:outgoing>
        <bpmn:messageEventDefinition id="MED_Disconnected"/>
      </bpmn:startEvent>
      <bpmn:endEvent id="End_Process_Stopped" name="Process stopped">
        <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Disconnect_End</bpmn:incoming>
        <bpmn:terminateEventDefinition id="TED_Stop"/>
      </bpmn:endEvent>
      <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Disconnect_End" sourceRef="Start_Disconnected" targetRef="End_Process_Stopped"/>
    </bpmn:subProcess>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="End_Measurement_Stopped" name="Measurement stopped">
      <bpmn:terminateEventDefinition id="TED_Main"/>
    </bpmn:endEvent>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Start" sourceRef="Start_Measurement" targetRef="Gateway_Measure_Merge"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_To_Availability" sourceRef="Gateway_Measure_Merge" targetRef="Task_Collect_Availability"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_To_Performance" sourceRef="Task_Collect_Availability" targetRef="Task_Collect_Performance"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_To_Quality" sourceRef="Task_Collect_Performance" targetRef="Task_Collect_Quality"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_To_Calculate" sourceRef="Task_Collect_Quality" targetRef="Task_Calculate"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_To_Check" sourceRef="Task_Calculate" targetRef="Gateway_OEE_Check"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Below_Threshold" name="OEE below threshold" sourceRef="Gateway_OEE_Check" targetRef="Task_Stop_Machine">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">${oeeBelowThreshold}</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Continue" name="Continue measuring" sourceRef="Gateway_OEE_Check" targetRef="Gateway_Measure_Merge"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_To_Email" sourceRef="Task_Stop_Machine" targetRef="Task_Send_Email"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_To_Wait_Restart" sourceRef="Task_Send_Email" targetRef="Event_Wait_Restart"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Restart_Resume" sourceRef="Event_Wait_Restart" targetRef="Gateway_Measure_Merge"/>
  </bpmn:process>
</bpmn:definitions>
